name: Morphing Julia Set
desc: A living escape-time Julia fractal whose complex parameter c orbits an incommensurate epicycle near the Mandelbrot boundary so the filigree endlessly morphs between dendrite, rabbit, dragon and spiral forms, rendered as an electric blue-violet field veined with gold filaments, glowing blackbody embers, drifting full-spectrum psychedelia, glacial cyan ice, or a copperplate contour engraving.

scale.doc: view zoom into the fractal (higher = deeper detail)
